name: AUCoreServiceRequestMinimal
title: AU Core ServiceRequest (minimal, hand-authored reproduction — see BUILD_LOG/fhir-gateway.md)
publisher: ReferralPlatform — NOT the official HL7 Australia AU Core IG
description: Minimal, hand-authored reproduction of the AU Core ServiceRequest profile's key cardinality constraints, used here as the referral document representation (a GP-to-specialist referral is modelled as a FHIR ServiceRequest, the standard FHIR pattern for a clinical request/order). Same caveat as au-core-patient.json: this is a hand-authored reproduction under the real canonical URL, not the officially downloaded AU Core IG package. Replace before relying on it for an actual AU Core conformance claim.

element.definition: The clinical reason for referral must not be absent — this is the substantive content of a referral document.
The referring GP — required so the referral is traceable to its author, per business-process-flow.md's GP traceability requirement.
